title: refactor: move accessibility help to native dialog
body:
[Issues]
- The OutlinerToolbar contained a native `<details>` element for keyboard accessibility help that disrupted the toolbar flow and took up vertical space.

[Changes]
- Removed the inline `<details>` element from `client/src/components/OutlinerToolbar.svelte`.
- Replaced it with a "Keyboard Shortcuts" button that triggers a native Svelte 5 `<dialog>` component.
- Used `a11yDialog.showModal()` to provide standard modal functionality (focus trapping, backdrop, and Esc-to-close behavior).

[Verification Results]
- Verified that `client/src/components/OutlinerToolbar.svelte` handles the dialog cleanly using `$effect` blocks in accordance with Svelte 5 practices.
- Ran `cd client && npm run lint` which passes without issues (resolved `a11y` suppression lint errors).
- Ran `cd client && npx vitest run src/components/OutlinerToolbar.test.ts` and all 10 unit tests passed.
- Ran `cd client && npx vitest run` and all 2376 test cases pass successfully.

---
